description: Single storey rear extension; blocking up of conservatory windows and installation of sliding doors to side and rear; external alterations to single storey side extension and installation of rooflights; creation of first floor roof terrace with glazed balustrade to side and rear elevations; alterations to conservatory to form flat roof; external alterations (demolition of attached rear store)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;03.10.202; 03.20.101 Rev A; 03.20.101 Rev A; 03.20.102 Rev A; 03.20.201 Rev A; 03.20.202; Design &amp; Access Statement dated 10.11.2025; Preliminary Ecological Assessment dated February 2026; Reasonable Exception Statement; 03.10.001 Rev A; 03.10.101 Rev A; 03.10.101 Rev A; 03.10.102 Rev A; 03.10.201 Rev A.

<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;;">The first floor flank balustrade on the side facing the adjoining property No.24 Brookshill Avenue shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained as such.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;;">Reason:&nbsp;</span><font face="Segoe UI">To safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</font></p>
